news.title: Heroic Ragefire Chasm Has Arrived!
news.body: Challenge Heroic Ragefire Chasm, face Knox the Dreadfang, and discover custom equipment, unique rewards, and a new mount. Enter through the Shattrath portal.
news.subtitle: A new level 70 dungeon adventure

news.title: New World Improvements
news.body: Relax beside a Basic Campfire to earn rested XP. Support your faction with Olive Tokens to activate powerful capital-city world blessings.
news.subtitle: More ways to enjoy Azeroth

news.title: The Siege of Orgrimmar Approaches
news.body: An army of 120 Alliance attackers prepares to march on Orgrimmar. The siege system has been developed, but the event remains disabled until final Live testing is complete.
news.subtitle: Massive capital battles are coming
